arm_labels.BF: Book I price, copy free (the unmodified engine)
arm_labels.FM: floor price, copy consumed (EXP-010's Arm M)

XD1.claim: #producing(FF u FM) - #producing(BF u BM) >= 8 of 24 each, and permutation p < 0.05

XD2.claim: |#producing(free arms) - #producing(matter arms)| is below the null's 95th percentile

XD3.claim: BF has the strictly lowest producing count of the four arms

XD4.claim: among seeds where a Book-priced and a floor-priced arm both collapse, the Book-priced arm dies earlier in >= 3 of every 4, sign-test p < 0.05
XD4.statistic: signed sign-test count (book earlier - floor earlier) over qualifying seeds

null_spec.model: permute the four arm labels within each seed, independently per seed
